# SMSM.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp2,718.0 against Rp1,595.0 (expected total return 79.9%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: derated_compounder_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Autos, components & dealerships.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- No scenario or analysis reconciles the model with the market. The bear is Rp2,425, 52% above the Rp1,595 price, so every outcome in the pack makes money, yet the report never asks why a 30% ROE, net-cash, 72%-payout busi
- The DCF carries 50% of the blend but the mandatory multiple-survival test is missing. The terminal value is 49.4% of the DCF (Rp24,450bn) and implies an exit of 8.87x EV/EBITDA on FY2035E against 4.64x entry and a 7.36x 
- The reverse DCF is mischaracterised three inconsistent ways. The model applies a -13.84pp increment from FY2027E only (implied -7.34% in FY2027E, worsening to -9.3% by FY2030E) leaving FY2026E at +7.65%; the thesis bulle

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
